summary: MSP Recovery, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a $0.1 million discretionary advance from Hazel Partners Holdings LLC under its existing working capital credit facility. The funds are for operating expenses, with no committed liquidity or borrowing base; the advance is a one-time increase to the Operational Collection Floor. No board recommendation or advisors are named. No price per share, premium, or deal terms typical of an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation are present. This is a routine liquidity arrangement, not a material corporate event. Watch for further financing needs.
